title: Get an Ocean City town business license
summary: Businesses that provide a service inside Ocean City's town limits need a Town of Ocean City business license, in addition to any state or county license.
action: Apply for (or renew) your town business license with the Ocean City Finance Department.
agency: Town of Ocean City Finance Department
frequencyNote: Check the renewal date with the town
verify: the law requires you to obtain a Town of Ocean City business license in addition to any State and/or County license
sourceName: Town of Ocean City: Rental & business licenses

title: Ocean City rental license and noise control permit
summary: Ocean City requires anyone who rents out property, for any length of time, to first get an annual town rental license and a noise control permit. Check with the town whether this covers your kind of lodging.
action: Ask the Ocean City Finance Department whether your lodging needs a rental license and noise control permit.
agency: Town of Ocean City Finance Department
verify: the law requires you to first obtain an annual Ocean City rental license, and noise control permit
sourceName: Town of Ocean City: Rental & business licenses

title: Get a Rockville hotel/motel license
summary: Rockville requires a city Hotel/Motel License to run a hotel or motel inside city limits. Rockville has no general business license, but it licenses a few specific activities like this one.
action: Apply for the Hotel/Motel License through the City of Rockville.
agency: City of Rockville, Community Planning and Development Services
frequencyNote: Check the renewal date with the city
verify: hotel/motel business within Rockville city limits
sourceName: City of Rockville: Apply for a business or rental license

title: Get College Park's annual Non-Residential Occupancy Permit
summary: College Park doesn't license businesses, but every business in the city needs two occupancy permits: a Use and Occupancy Permit from Prince George's County (DPIE) and an annual Non-Residential Occupancy Permit from the City.
action: Get your county Use and Occupancy Permit first, then apply to the City for the annual Non-Residential Occupancy Permit and renew it each year.
verify: an annual Non-Residential Occupancy Permit issued by the City of College Park
The City of College Park does not license businesses
sourceName: City of College Park: Business licenses & permits

title: Get an Annapolis Certificate of Use before opening
summary: Annapolis requires a Certificate of Use (the city's use and occupancy approval) before a business opens. The city suggests starting it before you sign a lease. Businesses in the downtown Historic District also need approval for most exterior work, including signs.
action: Apply for the Certificate of Use in the city's Citizen Self Service portal before you open.
verify: which is required prior to opening your business
sourceName: City of Annapolis: Start a business

title: Get a City of Laurel license to sell alcohol
summary: Laurel requires a city business license to sell alcoholic beverages, on top of the primary alcohol license from the Prince George's County Board of License Commissioners.
action: Get your county alcohol license, then apply for the City of Laurel license with the Fire Marshal and Permit Services office.
agency: City of Laurel, Department of the Fire Marshal and Permit Services
frequencyNote: Check the renewal date with the city
verify: Must apply and obtain a primary alcohol license through the Prince George's County Board of License Commissioners

title: City of Laurel amusement license
summary: Laurel requires a city license for amusements such as video games and game machines, billiard or pool rooms, juke boxes, cinema screens, and live entertainment.
action: If you offer any of these, apply for the City of Laurel amusement license.
agency: City of Laurel, Department of the Fire Marshal and Permit Services
verify: billiard or pool rooms, juke boxes, cinema screens, live entertainment

title: Get a City of Laurel mobile food vendor license
summary: Mobile food vendors need a City of Laurel business license to operate in the city.
action: Apply for the City of Laurel mobile food vendor license before selling in the city.
agency: City of Laurel, Department of the Fire Marshal and Permit Services
verify: Licenses are required for the following business

title: Get a Gaithersburg mobile food vendor license
summary: Gaithersburg requires a city license to sell food from a truck or street cart.
action: Apply for the Mobile Food Vendor License online or at City Hall.
verify: Mobile Food Vendor License A license to sell food from a truck or street cart

title: Register with Gaithersburg to do electrical work
summary: In Gaithersburg, anyone doing electrical work on a building they don't own must register with the City, which accepts State and Maryland county master electrician licenses.
action: If you do electrical work in the city, register with Gaithersburg and renew every two years.
verify: anyone doing electrical work on a building they do not own must be registered with the City

title: Get a Hagerstown contractor license
summary: Contractors, electricians, plumbers, and on-site utility contractors must get a Hagerstown license or registration before working in the city.
action: Apply for the Hagerstown contractor license (or electrician or plumber registration) before starting work in the city.
agency: City of Hagerstown, Permits and Inspections
verify: are required to secure a license or registration before they may legally practice their trade within Hagerstown
sourceName: City of Hagerstown: Licensing and registration

title: Greenbelt annual commercial license and inspection
summary: Non-residential buildings in Greenbelt must be licensed and inspected every year. The license goes to the property owner, so check with your landlord if you rent.
action: If you own your space, apply for the Commercial License and schedule the yearly inspection with Greenbelt Community Development.
verify: Non-residential structures in Greenbelt must be licensed and inspected on an annual basis
